wxWidgets 3.2.8 (vendored subset)

Source:   https://github.com/wxWidgets/wxWidgets/releases/download/v3.2.8/wxWidgets-3.2.8.tar.bz2
SHA-1:    a74d573d03068cd0e86396e13263f67ef3a4fc51  (matches the release notes)
SHA-256:  c74784904109d7229e6894c85cfa068f1106a4a07c144afd78af41f373ee0fe6
Licence:  wxWindows Library Licence (docs/licence.txt)
Added:    2026-11-18

Included (copied unchanged from the archive):
  CMakeLists.txt, README.md
  wx-config.in, wx-config-inplace.in  (read by build/cmake/config.cmake for every non-MSVC build,
                                      e.g. macOS; added 2026-11-21 after Jenkins #8 failed without them)
  include/  src/  3rdparty/
  art/                          (stock icons #included by src/common/artstd.cpp, arttango.cpp)
  build/cmake/
  build/bakefiles/version.bkl   (read by CMakeLists.txt for the library version)
  docs/licence.txt, licendoc.txt, lgpl.txt, gpl.txt, preamble.txt

Removed after copying:
  3rdparty/catch/.gitignore, 3rdparty/nanosvg/.gitignore, 3rdparty/pcre/.gitignore,
  src/tiff/.gitignore
  (upstream repository rules; src/tiff/.gitignore hid the pre-generated
  libtiff/tif_config.h and tiffconf.h, which the build needs)

Left out:
  docs/ (except the licence files), samples/, tests/, demos/, utils/, interface/,
  locale/, misc/, distrib/, lib/, the rest of build/ (bakefiles, msw, osx, ...),
  the other root-level autoconf/configure files, wxwidgets.props

Consequences for the CMake configuration:
  - wxUSE_XRC must be OFF (wxrc lives in utils/)
  - turning wxUSE_HTML OFF also needs wxUSE_WXHTML_HELP OFF (include/wx/chkconf.h)
  - wxBUILD_LOCALES OFF (locale/ is not included)
  - wxBUILD_SAMPLES / wxBUILD_TESTS / wxBUILD_DEMOS OFF (default)
  - do not run the wxWidgets install step (needs wxwidgets.props, build/msw/wx_setup.props)

Upgrading within 3.2.x: download the new archive, replace this folder with the same subset,
delete the nested .gitignore files again, update this file, and check that
`git ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard third_party/wxWidgets` prints nothing.
